# Which changes get a Claude security review (one list, used by the scope job
# of .github/workflows/security-review.yml and by `relevant-files.sh` locally).
#
# Each line is a git pathspec with glob magic (`**` = any number of folders).
# A changed file needs a review when it matches an include line and no line
# starting with "!" (exclude). Blank lines and lines starting with "#" are
# ignored. The workflow unites this list with the base branch's copy, so a PR
# can add paths but never drop its own files out of review. Check a branch:
#   bash .github/security-review/relevant-files.sh origin/main...HEAD

# Rust backend: every IPC command, the nav guard, downloads and SHA pins,
# process spawning, the cloud-consent gate (src-tauri/src/llm_commands.rs).
src-tauri/src/**
src-tauri/build.rs
src-tauri/Cargo.toml
# Tauri security config: CSP, asset scope, capabilities, updater key/endpoint,
# macOS entitlements, the NSIS hooks that run during install.
src-tauri/tauri*.conf.json
src-tauri/capabilities/**
src-tauri/Entitlements.plist
src-tauri/Info.plist
src-tauri/installer-hooks.nsi

# Workspace crates: storage and path containment, keychain, LLM providers,
# calendar OAuth, the MCP server, ASR / diarization sidecars, capture.
crates/*/src/**
crates/*/build.rs
crates/*/Cargo.toml
Cargo.toml
deny.toml

# Webview: renders untrusted transcripts, AI output and calendar text
# (safeContent.ts, markdownSafe.tsx) and calls every IPC command (api.ts).
frontend/src/**
frontend/index.html
frontend/vite.config.ts
frontend/package.json
package.json

# Scripts that build shipped binaries or run in CI with a token.
scripts/**

# CI, the release pipeline, agent config, the MCP skill, and this review's
# own machinery.
.github/workflows/**
.github/security-review/**
.github/tauri/**
.github/dependabot.yml
.github/zizmor.yml
.claude/**
.mcp.json
skills/**

# Never reviewed on their own: docs, tests, fixtures (meeting text and audio
# is prompt-injection material, not code), generated files, lockfiles (Dependabot
# + npm audit + cargo-deny cover them), static assets and styles.
# Paths not listed above are not reviewed either.
!**/*.md
!**/package-lock.json
!**/tests/**
!**/*.test.*
!**/*.spec.*
!**/fixtures/**
!**/benches/**
!src-tauri/gen/**
!src-tauri/icons/**
!frontend/src/assets/**
!frontend/src/devMock.ts
!**/*.css
!**/*.png
!**/*.jpg
!**/*.jpeg
!**/*.webp
!**/*.gif
!**/*.svg
!**/*.ico
!**/*.icns
!**/*.wav
!**/*.woff
